tagline: An agent that explains why data sources disagree, answering only with claims a critic has checked against Zetaris query results.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

zetaris.how: Data harness. All evidence is Lightning SQL sent to the Zetaris REST API (POST /sql-editor/sqls/run) against three views over live REST sources: edgar.revenue_facts (SEC XBRL companyconcept, 5 REST tables unioned), edgar.company_profiles (SEC submissions), company_dns.sic_codes_table (getting-started recipe 12). Cross-source joins run inside Zetaris.
zetaris.usl: explainwhy_usl (zetaris/02_usl.sql): 3 tables over 3 sources, FK/PK DQ rules; SHOW DQ ALL INVALID flags IBM (SIC 3570)
zetaris.live: Verified on a local Zetaris instance (Docker, 2.4.3); live queries in zetaris/live_results.md; live agent run in samples/outputs/zetaris-live-ibm/
zetaris.note: The three recorded sample runs and the eval used the SAMPLE_MODE local mirror of the same views so they replay offline. Details: ZETARIS.md

meterless.how: Minimal Python implementations of the Meterless engine specs. World Model: event-sourced investigation state, stable content IDs, idempotent ingest, version check; its log is the agent trace. H-MEM: file-based memory with mandatory source and provenance, the spec's hybrid retrieval score, supersession instead of deletion, feedback deltas, audit ledger; verified claims are stored and recalled on later questions. Markovian: each investigator step sees only the goal, the COMPLETED/REMAINING/DECISIONS/CONTEXT carryover and the latest result, with NEEDS_TOOL / STATE_CHECKPOINT / TASK_COMPLETE markers; 42-73% fewer prompt tokens than a full-transcript loop in the sample runs.

nvidia.how: Every agent role (planner, investigator, critic) runs on NVIDIA Nemotron: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Nebius Token Factory).

cursor.how: Not used: HackOS Cursor access instructions were still TBC on 27 Oct 2026. Code was written with Claude Code, which the AI Usage Policy allows.

sample_inputs: Why does Apple's revenue history under the us-gaap Revenues concept stop at fiscal year 2018?
Why does IBM drop out when EDGAR company profiles are joined to the company_dns SIC reference list?
Why does Tesla report revenue under two different XBRL concepts, and which one should be used for which years?
